evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: The contract is framed around the system's capability to deliver fast, reliable receipts — mastery of craft as the appealed-to good.
The appeal is to security and stability — preserving work against client failure, keeping what was produced.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The design preserves the agent's self-origination — choosing its own cadence to obtain results rather than being blocked.
